name: smwmusic-warioware-touched-gym-locker
title: WarioWare: Touched! - Gym Locker
description:
A jazzy, sleuthy song from a microgame where you unlock a safe. Full of güiro and triangle goodness. Kind of wish the microgame had a better name though.

Due to its short length, it's probably best suited for cutscenes or something. Includes an option to disable the loop.
